subject: Business Models
title: Negative Network Effects
description: Learn Negative Network Effects in one minute.

hook.text: Early Facebook was exclusive—only Harvard students. Then it opened to everyone and complaints started.

buildup.text: More users can create congestion, spam, and lower quality. A crowded nightclub loses its appeal.

discovery.text: Dating apps suffer this badly. Too many users leads to choice overload and lower match quality.

twist.text: Craigslist became unusable in some categories due to scammers. Growth attracted bad actors.

climax.text: Platforms must invest heavily in curation and moderation to prevent negative network effects.

punchline.text: More users, more noise. Growth can kill quality.

quiz.question: What causes negative network effects?
options: Growth reduces quality through congestion and spam
